walkthrough: The pulse travels Earth to Jupiter then Jupiter to Earth, so the measured $3960 \text{ s}$ is the round-trip time $t$. The one-way distance $d$ is half the total distance travelled.
Radio waves travel at the speed of light in vacuum, $c = 3.00 \times 10^{8} \text{ m s}^{-1}$. Use $\text{distance} = \text{speed} \times \text{time}$ for the whole journey.
Total round-trip distance $= c \times t = 3.00 \times 10^{8} \times 3960 = 1.188 \times 10^{12} \text{ m}$.
Convert to km: $1 \text{ km} = 1000 \text{ m}$, so $d = \frac{5.94 \times 10^{11}}{1000} = 5.94 \times 10^{8} \text{ km}$. This is option A.
